name: Lu Raise
instructions: Stand holding a light barbell or plates in front of your thighs.
Raise the bar in an arc up and out until it is overhead.
Keep a slight bend in the elbows and your core braced.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: A barbell raise with a slight lean that targets the front and side deltoids.
